---
title: "link-external: named icon"
# bd-t3n1nghb: a string `link-external-icon` places a Bootstrap Icons
# span after each external link (no `external` class), and the icons
# stylesheet ships even though this is not a website.
format:
  html:
    link-external-icon: box-arrow-up-right
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      noErrorsOrWarnings: true
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - [
            'a[href="https://example.com/"] + span.bi.bi-box-arrow-up-right.quarto-ext-icon[aria-hidden="true"]',
          ]
        - [
            'a.external',
            'a[href="about.html"] + span.quarto-ext-icon',
            'a[target]',
          ]
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        - ['<link rel="stylesheet" href="[^"]*bootstrap-icons\.css">']
        - []
---

An [internal](about.html) link and an [external](https://example.com/) one.
